question: Should OpenClaw guarantee a child-visible warning before fixed run deadlines, and should it share one control primitive and configuration model with the inactivity nudge in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39305?
rationale: The feature adds public lifecycle and configuration behavior, while the generic ACP adapter contract cannot currently guarantee steering an active child across backends.

options.title: Unify warning controls
options.body: Introduce one capability-aware child-control mechanism supporting fixed-deadline warnings and inactivity nudges with a minimal shared policy surface.

options.title: Deadline warning only
options.body: Implement only a global fixed-deadline warning for runtimes that can safely receive it and keep inactivity recovery separately tracked.

options.title: Keep prompt-based checkpointing
options.body: Add no lifecycle or configuration surface and continue relying on task instructions plus existing post-timeout recovery.

recommendation.title: Unify warning controls
recommendation.body: Introduce one capability-aware child-control mechanism supporting fixed-deadline warnings and inactivity nudges with a minimal shared policy surface.
